text:
marta: quick note from usability run — users misread the notification preview when suppressions are active. they expected suppressed channels to be marked per-row, not hidden.

kai: saw same. collapsed preview made people think channels were deleted.

sam: implementation idea: keep suppressed channels visible but de-emphasized, add a small "suppressed" badge in each row and a tooltip that says "suppressed until 4:00 PM local". avoids the missing-channel confusion.

a11y-bot: accessibility: don't rely on color alone. include text and an aria-label like "Suppressed until 4:00 PM Pacific Time" and ensure badges are keyboard-focusable. also announce preview updates with an aria-live region: "Preview updated: 3 channels will receive alerts, 2 channels suppressed."

marta: copy draft for badge: "Suppressed until 4:00 PM (local)". short alt: "Suppressed". Tooltip: "This channel will not receive notifications until 4:00 PM. Click to edit schedule."

kai: plus one on explicit timestamp in tooltip. testers confused about timezone without it.

sam: tech note: preview should compute recipients by applying route defaults then SLO overrides then channel overrides. i'll add telemetry `preview_effective_recipients` to validate.

a11y-bot: final checklist for spec: include aria-describedby for tooltips, role=status for validation messages, keyboard focus states for badges, and contrast >= 4.5:1 for small helper text or increase size.

marta: thanks. i'll update Figma with per-row badges + tooltip copy and post link. ping me for PR review. :thumbsup:
